# Virtual display mode list.
# The first line that is not a comment is the number of VIRTUAL DISPLAYS to create,
# not a count of modes. No line number is given on purpose: it moves whenever a
# comment is added or removed, and a stale one is worse than none.
# Every following line is one mode: width, height, refresh rate.
# Lines starting with # are ignored. Modes outside the edid_mode_filtering
# range in vdd_settings.xml are skipped with a warning in the driver log.
